limitations: Raw model estimates are experimental, not calibrated election probabilities.
The cohort is selected for competitiveness and evidence availability; it does not represent the country.
Ranges show only the tested orderings, not confidence intervals.
Coverage is incomplete. Missing sources and failed forecasts remain visible.
Focus groups are qualitative evidence, not representative samples of an electorate.
House locations are state-level unless a verified district boundary is explicitly supplied.
The initial snapshot is exploratory. The primary evaluation uses the predeclared final snapshot.
